name: music-maker-plugin
description: Full-stack AI music producer plugin for composing, arranging, mixing, and ear-auditing instrumental music and beats with SoundFonts (.sf2), covering advanced Piano comping & voicing (Category A/B rootless, 3-7 voice leading, Fourths/So What, Clusters, Upper Structure Triads, Wynton Kelly & Red Garland syncopation, C3-C6 non-collision, Gundlach/Drotos/Stevens pop patterns, Afro-Cuban montuno/clave independence), advanced Bass arranging & low-end craft (Dyas Cycle Patterns, Ithaca 4-step walking, enclosures, Afro-Cuban tumbao & clave, Brazilian samba surdo weight, Jamerson Motown, funk ghosts/A-B-A-C Q&A grooves, sub-100 Hz kick-bass clarity), Pop Ballad craft (0.618 tension arcs, descending slash bass, studio strings & high descants, tutti kicks), melody harmonization & reharmonization, advanced harmony (Neo-Riemannian PLR, Negative Harmony, Lendvai, LCC, CMCR, Barry Harris, Coltrane cycles), counterpoint/fugue/post-tonal, symphonic & Big-Band orchestration, drum/groove architecture, guitar/bass MPE expression, aligned multi-track WAV stems, and multi-duration audio listening QA.
suggestedPrompts: Activate music_maker_plugin and compose an original instrumental beat with expressive dynamics, pedal sustain, and full multi_track stems.
Design a symphonic or Big-Band arrangement with Upper Structure voicings, Neo-Riemannian/Negative Harmony reharmonization, ACTOR timbre blending, and verified WAV/MIDI output.
